title: Fix an Unschedulable CPU Request
prompt:
The Pod of Deployment `web` in namespace `cka-wl-resources` fails to schedule and remains `Pending` (`Insufficient cpu`).

Perform the following tasks:
1. Adjust the CPU request of Deployment `web` to `100m` so the Pod schedules cleanly.
2. Keep the container image `nginx:1.27-alpine`.

manifests:
apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: Deployment
metadata:
  name: web
  namespace: cka-wl-resources
spec:
  replicas: 1
  selector:
    matchLabels:
      app: web
  template:
    metadata:
      labels:
        app: web
    spec:
      containers:
      - name: web
        image: nginx:1.27-alpine
        resources:
          requests:
            cpu: "4"
            memory: 64Mi

checks.description: Pod of Deployment `web` is Running and Ready
checks.failure_hint: Lower the CPU request so the scheduler can place the Pod.

reference_solution:
Lower the CPU request.
```bash
kubectl -n cka-wl-resources patch deployment web --type=merge -p='{"spec":{"template":{"spec":{"containers":[{"name":"web","image":"nginx:1.27-alpine","resources":{"requests":{"cpu":"100m","memory":"64Mi"}}}]}}}}'
```
hints: Check why pods remain Pending using `k -n cka-wl-resources describe pod` and inspect node allocatable CPU.
Reduce CPU requests on container `web` inside Deployment `web` so pods fit worker capacity while keeping 2 replicas.
fast_solution_commands: k -n cka-wl-resources describe nodes | grep -A4 Allocated
